rules.new_licensee_rule: Graduated in the first year of the renewal biennium: half the hours; in the second year: no CE for that renewal.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; subject to board audit; keep certificates for at least 5 years.
rules.notes: 3 h per cycle (1.5 h/year) on KASPER use, pain management or addiction disorders. Min 10 h live interactive. Charity care, office business and association meetings max 10 h. Current AHA-level CPR required. HIV/AIDS education per KRS 214.615(1).
